BasicMultiToken.tokens array holding the underlying ERC20 tokens

msg.sender untrusted external caller address
Ownable constructor assigning owner from msg.sender
renounceOwnership restricted to onlyOwner, zeroes owner
transferOwnership restricted to onlyOwner
internal _transferOwnership writing new owner address
pause restricted by onlyOwner and whenNotPaused
unpause restricted by onlyOwner and whenPaused
init configures tokens, name, symbol and decimals once
bundleFirstTokens bundles when total supply is zero
bundle computes proportional token amounts and mints value
unbundle delegates to unbundleSome with all tokens
unbundleSome burns value and returns proportional inner tokens
internal _bundle pulls tokens and mints multi tokens
lend performs flash loan and arbitrary external call
approveAndCall approves spender then makes arbitrary call
transferAndCall transfers then makes arbitrary call
ERC1003Token.transferFrom override resolving sender from stack
makeCall performs onlyOwner low-level call.value to target
change swaps one underlying token for another using weights
setLendFee onlyOwner setter bounded to 3 percent
setChangeFee onlyOwner setter bounded to 3 percent
setRefferalFee onlyOwner setter bounded to 50 percent
FeeMultiToken.change wraps changeWithRef with zero referral

deploy onlyOwner deploys FeeMultiToken and calls init data
BasicToken.transfer standard balance transfer

checkedTransfer library call validating balance change

caller_.makeCall.value(msg.value)(_target,_data) arbitrary call inside lend
_token.transfer(_to,_amount) external token transfer before callback

_tokens[i].checkedTransfer to beneficiary inside token loop
ERC20(_toToken).checkedTransfer(_ref, refferalAmount) external transfer

_changeFee setter parameter
_refferalFee setter parameter

approveAndCall pushes msg.sender onto sendersStack_
renounceOwnership is reachable only through the onlyOwner modifier
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner
pause is guarded by onlyOwner
unpause is guarded by onlyOwner
setLendFee is restricted by onlyOwner
setChangeFee is restricted by onlyOwner
setRefferalFee is restricted by onlyOwner
MultiTokenDeployer.deploy is restricted by onlyOwner
approveAndCall is public and records caller before arbitrary call
unbundleSome burns balances[msg.sender] without any allowance check
change pulls tokens from msg.sender via checkedTransferFrom
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in onlyOwner guarding renounceOwnership
owner state variable gates transferOwnership
_transferOwnership writes the owner state variable
owner state variable gates pause
owner state variable gates setLendFee
owner state variable gates deploy
paused flag is checked by whenNotPaused on pause
paused flag is checked by whenNotPaused on _bundle
_tokens parameter supplied to BasicMultiToken.init

_amount parameter drives the minted amount in bundle

_value parameter is subtracted from balances in unbundleSome

_token parameter selects the lent token in lend
_amount parameter is the lent value in lend
_target parameter selects the arbitrary call receiver in lend
_data parameter is forwarded as calldata in lend

_data flows into the arbitrary makeCall invocation
_token is the token transferred out in lend
_amount is the value transferred out in lend

_toToken selects the output token of change
_minReturn enforces slippage protection in change
_ref receives the referral token transfer

_changeFee parameter is stored into changeFee
_refferalFee parameter is stored into refferalFee

caller supplied data is executed by the low-level call in deploy
_from is the source address in ERC1003Token.transferFrom override
_newOwner is written to the owner state variable
tokenAmounts array elements feed the transferFrom call in _bundle
totalSupply snapshot divides the tokenAmount computation
computed tokenAmount is sent via checkedTransfer
computed refferalAmount is transferred to _ref

resolved from address is forwarded to super.transferFrom

bundle invokes the internal _bundle routine
bundleFirstTokens invokes the internal _bundle routine
unbundle simply delegates to unbundleSome
_bundle loops over tokens performing external transferFrom calls
unbundleSome loops over tokens performing checkedTransfer
lend performs the arbitrary external call after transferring tokens
lend transfers the underlying token out before the external call
makeCall executes the low-level call.value
approveAndCall invokes caller_.makeCall giving control to an arbitrary contract
transferAndCall invokes caller_.makeCall giving control to an arbitrary contract
ERC1003Token.transferFrom override calls super.transferFrom
changeWithRef calls super.change before paying the referral
FeeMultiToken.lend calls super.lend and then checks the fee
FeeMultiToken.change delegates to changeWithRef
changeWithRef performs the external referral token transfer
deploy calls the freshly deployed contract with attacker data
change calls the external checkedTransferFrom library which invokes the token contract
setLendFee writes the lendFee state variable
setChangeFee writes the changeFee state variable
setRefferalFee writes the refferalFee state variable
weights mapping values are used in the change pricing formula
minimalWeight participates in the change return computation
init writes the tokens array
init writes the decimals state variable
arbitrary call to _target can re-enter lend before the refill requirement is checked
arbitrary call can re-enter change while a loan is outstanding
arbitrary call can re-enter changeWithRef during the loan window
external transferFrom on an untrusted token can re-enter _bundle before supply accounting completes
external checkedTransfer on an untrusted token can re-enter unbundleSome after the balance burn
external token transfer to _ref can re-enter changeWithRef
arbitrary call with attacker data can re-enter deploy
low-level call.value forwards all remaining gas to an arbitrary address
checkedTransfer library performs external token calls during unbundle flows
sendersStack_.length -= 1 is an unchecked underflow on array length
inLendingMode += 1 and -= 1 are unchecked counter arithmetic in lend

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is a plain input address written to the owner state variable inside _transferOwnership
_tokens is only used to populate the tokens storage array in init
_amount is the minting amount consumed by bundle before reaching _bundle
_beneficiary is the receiver of minted multi tokens in bundle
_value is the burned amount deducted from balances in unbundleSome
_to is the flash loan recipient passed straight through lend
_token is the ERC20 transferred out by the lend token transfer operation
_amount is the value passed to the external token transfer in lend
_target is the callee address of the arbitrary call in lend
_data is the calldata forwarded to the arbitrary call in lend
_fromToken indexes the weights and ERC20 used by change
_toToken is the destination token of change
_minReturn is the slippage requirement enforced by change
_ref is the recipient of the external referral transfer
_from is resolved and forwarded to the super transferFrom implementation
data is the attacker influenceable payload of the low-level call in deploy
_lendFee is the only input written into the lendFee state variable
_changeFee is the only input written into the changeFee state variable
_refferalFee is the only input written into the refferalFee state variable
tokenAmounts is the per token amount passed to the external transferFrom in _bundle
totalSupply is a snapshot local only used inside the unbundleSome payout math
tokenAmount is the computed value handed to the external checkedTransfer
prevBalance is only used to validate the balance around the lend token transfer
refferalAmount is the computed amount passed to the external referral transfer
from is the resolved address handed to super.transferFrom
returnAmount is the base value used to derive the referral fee transfer amount
